run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute minimum insertions needed to sort an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that calculates minimum insertions to sort an array using LIS
review_f_gold: review the f_gold dynamic programming solution for minimum insertions to sort an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use bisect for an O(N log N) LIS computation instead of O(N squared)
